name: Comms Array
narrativeOnEnter: Tight room. Transmitter console and equipment racks. Distress beacon blinking orange — active, unconfirmed.

hotspots.label: External Airlock
hotspots.lockedMessage: External airlock is in emergency lockdown — reactor instability prevents safe EVA. Stabilise the reactor first.

action.text:
DISTRESS BEACON PROTOCOL

Beacon active. To confirm evacuation:
1. Stabilise reactor
2. Access pod bay — OR use external airlock EVA route

Beacon auto-signals shuttle on reactor stabilisation.

───
Kovalev's note inside:

'Do NOT let the beacon auto-signal MERIDIAN-3.
Manually transmit on 148.350 MHz.

HELIOS GROUP = AXIOM. Their shuttle has a portable SRR extraction unit.
Do not give them a window to pull the buffer data.

CALLISTO is the real rescue — IREX Board whistleblower network.
They have testimony from Dr. Voss (Blackwood) and Kira Reiss (Arcadia).

Transmit: "Buffer is clean. Kovalev's message."
— D.K.'

Two active signals.

SIGNAL 1 — MERIDIAN-3:
'Holding position. Awaiting reactor status before approach.'

SIGNAL 2 — 148.350 MHz (encrypted):
CALLISTO / IREX BOARD:
'WE KNOW ABOUT HELIOS. WE HAVE THE BLACKWOOD FILES.
DO NOT BOARD MERIDIAN-3. THEY ARE EXTRACTION.
WHEN REACTOR IS STABLE: TRANSMIT. WE WILL COME IN.'

───
A second burst, timestamp 03:41 — the moment Arcadia went dark. Origin: unknown.

'ALL 47. AND NOW ALL 6.
THE DATA MUST NOT REACH AXIOM.
— P'

EXTERNAL AIRLOCK — EVA STATUS

Status: LOCKED (Reactor radiation field active)
Clearance required: Reactor deck — NOMINAL status

Once reactor is stabilised, this airlock will automatically unlock.
Distance to rescue shuttle: 40 metres. EVA tether required.
